claim_boundary: Static read-set audit; REVIEW findings require semantic confirmation before promotion to defects.

findings.evidence: SYSTEM_ARCHITECTURE_V2 still says mesh-weight typed seam open/unsealed while MESH_WEIGHT_BINDING_CONTRACT_V1 and Stage36 typed mesh-skin transfer exist.

seal.reason: Post-seal appearance fidelity review found unresolved product blockers: fixed CAA tile_resolution=8 lacks source-frequency/texel-density qualification; deterministic unobserved completion is nearest-surface copy rather than high-fidelity source-constrained completion; cross-view RGB compatibility lacks explicit qualification authority; Stage45 dynamic alpha holes are diagnostic rather than a hard gate; speckled/scattered-hole artifact class is not independently bounded. Native CAA currently uses premultiplied bilinear only; mip/minification and anisotropic sampling stability under motion are not yet qualified. Independent red-team additionally found Euclidean cross-surface completion risk, donor-view ranking weakness, same-provenance seam blindness/source-view provenance loss, owner-denominator crack blindness, XY-only contact proof under Z-up object frame, playback/proof sampling mismatch, missing explicit dynamic self-intersection qualification, and a referenced visual-fidelity recalibration artifact that does not yet exist.
